name: throw-catch-tuple
code:
log=[]
def g():
 try:
  yield "pause"
 except ValueError as e:
  log.append(("caught", type(e).__name__, e.args[0]))
  yield "recovered"
it=g()
next(it)
print(it.throw(ValueError("boom")))
print(log)
